data.name: Pricing_Faq_Title
data.value: Everything you need to know about our 40k annual plan

data.name: Pricing_Faq_Desc
data.value: Clear answers regarding domain registration, renewals, payment methods, and features.

data.name: Pricing_Faq1_Q
data.value: Is it really ₦40,000 for the whole year with everything included?

data.name: Pricing_Faq1_A
data.value: Yes. For ₦40,000 you get full access to the complete Ozikol commerce platform for a full 365 days. There are no tier restrictions, no per-transaction fees, and no hidden monthly costs.

data.name: Pricing_Faq2_Q
data.value: What do you mean by 'you only buy your domain'?

data.name: Pricing_Faq2_A
data.value: You buy your custom domain name (such as mybusiness.com or mybusiness.ng) directly from any domain registrar of your choice. Ozikol provides everything else: cloud hosting, SSL encryption, database, POS, inventory, and all software features.

data.name: Pricing_Faq3_Q
data.value: Can I use an existing domain I already own?

data.name: Pricing_Faq3_A
data.value: Yes. If you already have a domain registered anywhere in the world, you can connect it to your Ozikol store in minutes by adding the DNS records shown in your admin dashboard.

data.name: Pricing_Faq4_Q
data.value: Can I pay in US Dollars, British Pounds, or Ghanaian Cedis?

data.name: Pricing_Faq4_A
data.value: Yes. International businesses can pay in USD ($25/year), GBP (£20/year), or Ghanaian Cedi (GH₵350/year). You can select your currency at any time using the currency switcher.

data.name: Pricing_Faq5_Q
data.value: What happens at the end of the 1-year period?

data.name: Pricing_Faq5_A
data.value: Your subscription renews at the same transparent flat rate. You will receive reminder notices 30 days before renewal, and you are free to export all your business data at any time.

data.name: Pricing_Faq6_Q
data.value: Is there a free trial before I pay ₦40,000?

data.name: Pricing_Faq6_A
data.value: Yes. You can test all features with a 14-day free trial. No credit card or upfront payment is required to explore and set up your store.
